Function starts + internal call/jump targets only (not blind per-byte entries), so trailing/embedded data tables like $45ff are left as data. Added instead: $42d0/$43db/$43f1 (twin-proven code -- 398/131/109 bytes identical to MoveMenuCursor2GridRemote_16/ClearWram3Row64_16/ClearWram3Row64Alt_16) and $6bc2 (19-byte predicate whose three jr z all land on the already-carved $6bd5).
